Smoke num_params_M != 592.9, or ngram_ve / architecture oneliners differ from the same-host control smoke (unexpected side effect; do not launch full).
Smoke causality_passed is not True, or any NaN/inf loss in the smoke log.
Smoke steps < 342 (below +2% of the 335-step control smoke) or step-rate ratio vs same-host control smoke < 1.02 (throughput hypothesis falsified at smoke).
Smoke public_val_bpb > same-host control smoke + 0.003 (1.165604 trn22 / 1.165855 trn21).
Full run completes < 90% of same-host control steps (CONFOUNDED-SHORT; record as throughput regression only).
Full run steps > +10% of control: do not declare SUCCESS without the matched-step trajectory comparison described in the outcome classes.

expected_effect: Steps in 1800 s increase by 5-12% over same-host control (about 2175-2320 vs 2071/2076); public_val_bpb decreases by 0.002-0.006 (target <= 1.0037 trn21 / <= 1.0040 trn22). Falsified if steps are within +/-1% of control (inert) or if steps rise >= 2% but public_val_bpb is not lower than control by at least 0.001 (quality loss from BF16 norm outputs outweighs recovered steps).
hypothesis: At 9a4caa7b under the pinned environment (NEURON_CC_FLAGS='--optlevel=1', no compiler matmul autocast), the transformer blocks' linear projections consume FP32 RMSNorm outputs, so the dominant per-step cost is FP32 matmul/transposition work. The existing --bf16-sdpa-input arm proved that a single precision-boundary cast recovers steps without quality loss under a fixed 1800 s budget (2233 vs 2076 steps, 1.002028 vs 1.005967 BPB, trn22). --bf16-norm-output is the analogous, independent boundary (norm outputs cast to BF16 before the qkv/MLP projections; the verifier-cited train.py 3174-3189 region selects SDPA precision independently of norm-output precision). Every fresh-start KEEP configuration (fs-w50..fs-w146, 0.979-0.993 BPB) carried --bf16-norm-output, but no smoke or full ledger row and no DECISION_LOG row exists for this flag at 9a4caa7b (an earlier proposal id was allocated but never executed). Prediction: >=+5% steps within the same 1800 s and lower final public_val_bpb, because BF16 rounding of normalized activations (unit-scale, well-conditioned) costs far less loss than the extra optimizer steps recover.
single_causal_change: Pass --bf16-norm-output only. Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: identical launch shape (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=4, --num-steps 5000, --max-train-seconds 1800, --seed 42), identical environment (NEURON_CC_FLAGS exactly '--optlevel=1', NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_SEED=42, PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1), no --bf16-sdpa-input, no --ngram-rms-fp32, no --nki-* or --compile-* flag, no optimizer/schedule/batch/architecture/ngram-ve/evaluation change. Pre-full checks from the smoke: resolved precision oneliner shows bf16_norm_output=True and bf16_sdpa_input=False; num_params_M 592.9; ngram_ve oneliner identical to control ('True tables=4 rows=1048576 dim=128 ... trigram=True ... bf16=True rms_fp32_state_math=False nki_rms=False'); architecture oneliners identical to control; causality_passed True. If the resolved precision oneliner does not show bf16_norm_output=True, or any other oneliner differs from control, classify HALT-SEMANTIC-REVIEW and do not launch the full run. Comparison: same-host pinned control on public_val_bpb (trn21 2071 / 1.005734; trn22 2076 / 1.005967). Outcome classes evaluated in order: (1) HALT-SEMANTIC-REVIEW as above; (2) CONFOUNDED-SHORT if full-run steps < 90% of same-host control (<1864 trn21, <1869 trn22); (3) FALSIFIED-INERT if steps within +/-1% of control (norm-output precision is not a measurable cost); (4) EXCESS-GAIN-REVIEW if steps > +10% of control (>2278 trn21, >2283 trn22): record throughput and BPB; before any quality claim compare the candidate's logged validation trajectory against the control's at matched step counts; if matched-step trajectories are unavailable, quality attribution is recorded unresolved; SUCCESS may still be declared only if public_val_bpb < control by >= 0.001 and no matched-step deficit > 0.010 at the control's final step; (5) SUCCESS if steps >= +2% and public_val_bpb < same-host control by >= 0.001; (6) FALSIFIED-QUALITY if steps >= +2% and public_val_bpb >= control (BF16 rounding of normalized activations costs more than the recovered steps); (7) INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Secondary, non-verdict analysis: record this arm next to the bf16-sdpa-input KEEP as the second independently validated precision boundary; a later stack-confirmation run (both flags) is a separate proposal with its own interaction hypothesis.
